title: MasterFailoverTest.TestDeleteTableSync fails sporadically with "Operation submitted in term X cannot be replicated in term Y"
body:
This might be related to the recent changes to enforce the term.

```
yb_build.sh --cxx-test integration-tests_master_failover-itest --gtest_filter MasterFailoverTest.TestDeleteTableSync
```
